findings.title: Payment.create called without idempotency_key in old code path
findings.body: The new function signature adds `idempotency_key`, but the call on line 11 passes only three positional arguments. `Payment.create` expects `order_id`, `amount_cents`, and `idempotency_key` in that order. This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime.

findings.title: New parameter lacks type hint in docstring
findings.body: The function signature on line 7 adds a new required parameter `idempotency_key`, but the docstring does not document it. This breaks the local convention of documenting all parameters in the function signature.
findings.suggestion:
def record_payment(order_id: str, amount_cents: int, idempotency_key: str) -> Payment:
    """Record a payment with idempotency.

    Args:
        order_id: The order identifier.
        amount_cents: The payment amount in cents.
        idempotency_key: Unique key to ensure idempotency.

    Returns:
        The created or existing Payment.
    """

summary.problem: The new idempotency feature introduces a runtime error and omits parameter documentation.
summary.done_well: Idempotency is implemented with a lookup before creation, reducing duplicate payments.
